title: Resolution urging Albany to regulate crypto kiosks against fraud
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass and the Governor to sign S.9891-B/A.10899-C, which would regulate cryptocurrency kiosks statewide. The bill would require kiosks to display fraud warnings, verify virtual currency wallets and let fraud victims seek reimbursement. The Council cites FBI data showing 318 New York complaints of kiosk fraud totaling $5,777,640 in losses, with older adults disproportionately affected.
